queries: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(copies) AS average_copies FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(rc.copies) AS total_copies, AVG(rc.copies - ra.average_copies) AS average_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra WHERE rc.copies > ra.average_copies

WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copy_count FROM inventory AS i JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(copy_count) AS avg_copies FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(rc.copy_count) AS total_copies, AVG(rc.copy_count - ra.avg_copies) AS avg_excess_copies FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra WHERE rc.copy_count > ra.avg_copies
